label: ProductPortfolio
definition: A governed strategic arrangement organizing products, entries and planning references under a continuing portfolio mandate.

label: Product
definition: A governed intentional product artifact with continuing constitutive purpose and stewardship lineage; not a deployment or a database row.

label: OfferingSpecification
definition: A catalog specification of how one product is intended to be offered to an audience under stated terms.

label: BundleSpecification
definition: A governed composition specification referencing offerings intended to be presented together.

label: ProductVersion
definition: An immutable approved specification baseline for one Product.

label: LifecycleSpecification
definition: An authored scheme describing lifecycle-stage meanings applicable to products.

label: LifecycleStageSpecification
definition: A scoped definition of a lifecycle stage within one lifecycle specification.

label: ProductStatusRecord
definition: A dated contextual assertion assigning a status value to one product.

label: DependencySpecification
definition: An authored claim that one product depends on an identified product, capability or resource under a stated dependency condition.

label: ProductFamilyReference
definition: A local reference artifact identifying a product-family target governed by an external owner. Its product-family purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.

label: ProductLineReference
definition: A local reference artifact identifying an externally governed product line. Its product-line purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.

label: ProductVariantReference
definition: A local reference artifact identifying an externally governed product variant. Its product-variant purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.

label: PortfolioEntry
definition: A governed entry in one portfolio, optionally referencing a product while a broader target binding is being specified.

label: VisionStatement
definition: An authored statement articulating intended product direction, experience and value.

label: GoalSpecification
definition: An authored ConditionSpecification whose constitutive content includes desired product condition. The facet belongs to this specification baseline, not to a temporary use of its file or an actual occurrence.

label: OutcomeSpecification
definition: An authored ConditionSpecification whose constitutive content includes expected measurable product condition. The facet belongs to this specification baseline, not to a temporary use of its file or an actual occurrence.

label: ProductMetricReference
definition: A local reference artifact binding a product measurement context to an externally governed metric. Its product-metric purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.

label: InitiativeSpecification
definition: An authored plan coordinating goals, scope and expected product outcomes.

label: ProblemStatement
definition: A governed statement artifact describing a candidate or evidenced problem.

label: OpportunityStatement
definition: A governed statement artifact identifying a possible value improvement in context.

label: HypothesisSpecification
definition: An authored testable-claim artifact fixing its claim, intended scope and refutation or support conditions.

label: SolutionHypothesisSpecification
definition: A hypothesis specification whose constitutive claim concerns a proposed solution addressing a problem.

label: DecisionRecord
definition: An immutable record of a product decision, its considered alternatives, rationale and provenance.

label: DecisionCriterionSpecification
definition: An authored rule or criterion specification used to appraise product alternatives.

label: ProblemSolutionFitAssessment
definition: A dated assessment record about the proposed fit of a problem statement and a solution specification.

label: ProductMarketFitAssessment
definition: A dated assessment record about a product in an explicitly identified market context.

label: ScopeSpecification
definition: An authored specification of included, excluded and deferred product scope.

label: CapabilitySpecification
definition: A version-scoped specification of an intended ability, irrespective of its implementation.

label: SolutionSpecification
definition: An authored product-level solution proposal describing how problems or opportunities are intended to be addressed.

label: FeatureSpecification
definition: An authored functional-unit specification linking intended behavior, user value and acceptance criteria.

label: VerticalSliceSpecification
definition: An authored end-to-end increment specification connecting intended value to coherent behavior and acceptance conditions.

label: EnablerSpecification
definition: An authored supporting-work specification intended to enable a feature or capability specification.

label: UserStorySpecification
definition: An authored user-centered narrative specifying a desired interaction goal and expected value.

label: RequirementSpecification
definition: An authored ConditionSpecification whose constitutive content includes required product condition. The facet belongs to this specification baseline, not to a temporary use of its file or an actual occurrence.

label: FunctionalRequirementSpecification
definition: A requirement specification with an essential normative commitment about intended behavior or functionality.

label: QualityRequirementSpecification
definition: A requirement specification with an essential normative commitment about a measurable quality under defined conditions.

label: ConstraintSpecification
definition: An authored ConditionSpecification whose constitutive content includes restriction constitutive to the authored specification. The facet belongs to this specification baseline, not to a temporary use of its file or an actual occurrence.

label: BusinessRuleReference
definition: A local reference artifact to an externally governed business rule. Its business-rule purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.

label: AcceptanceCriterionSpecification
definition: An authored ConditionSpecification whose constitutive content includes condition used in the authored acceptance contract. The facet belongs to this specification baseline, not to a temporary use of its file or an actual occurrence.

label: RequirementScenarioSpecification
definition: An authored ScenarioSpecification whose constitutive content includes requirement/acceptance illustration. The facet belongs to this specification baseline, not to a temporary use of its file or an actual occurrence.

label: RequirementSourceReference
definition: A local provenance reference artifact identifying an origin used in deriving a requirement specification. Its requirement-source purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.

label: RequirementRationaleStatement
definition: An authored justification statement explaining why a requirement specification is needed.

label: ValidationFindingRecord
definition: A FindingRecord whose constitutive subject matter includes a requirement specification.

label: PersonaSpecification
definition: An authored model of a user archetype, fixing a behavioral profile, population/use context and research provenance; not a person, group of actual users or their temporary role.

label: UserRoleSpecification
definition: A designed specification of a user participation context, responsibilities and permissions.

label: JourneySpecification
definition: An authored structured experience model containing scoped stage specifications.

label: JourneyStageSpecification
definition: An authored constituent stage specification owned by exactly one JourneySpecification.

label: TouchpointSpecification
definition: A design artifact specifying a point of contact, its channel, purpose and interaction context.

label: UserFlowSpecification
definition: An authored sequence model of user actions, decisions and transitions.

label: InteractionStepSpecification
definition: A scoped action or decision-step specification in one user-flow design.

label: InformationArchitectureSpecification
definition: An authored model of information organization, hierarchy and navigation.

label: ScreenSpecification
definition: An authored view specification with layout, interaction and state commitments.

label: UIStateSpecification
definition: A scoped specification of a screen condition and its expected presentation or interaction.

label: UsabilityFindingRecord
definition: A FindingRecord whose constitutive subject matter includes a user-flow or screen specification.

label: Roadmap
definition: A governed planning-projection artifact referencing canonical product knowledge.

label: RoadmapEntry
definition: A scoped entry in one roadmap referencing intended initiatives, features or delivery targets.

label: MilestoneSpecification
definition: An authored target-condition specification marking intended planning progress.

label: PriorityAssessment
definition: A dated contextual ranking assessment recording a rank for a roadmap entry within a named comparison set and scale.

label: PrioritizationCriterionSpecification
definition: A decision-criterion specification whose constitutive purpose is to justify or compute a planning rank.

label: PlanningHorizonDefinition
definition: A governed term definition specifying the meaning of a planning-horizon label in a named scheme.

label: TargetWindowAssignment
definition: A planning record assigning a bounded target interval to one roadmap entry.

label: ConfidenceAssessment
definition: A dated assessment of planning confidence with explicit subject, assessor, evidence context and scale.

label: CommitmentLevelDefinition
definition: A governed term definition for a planning-commitment label within a named scheme.

label: ReleaseSpecification
definition: A governed specification of a planned delivery increment and its intended contents.

label: DeliveryWorkItem
definition: A governed work-item artifact about intended delivery scope and its referenced functional specifications.

label: ChangeRecord
definition: A dated record describing an asserted modification to an identified product artifact or state.

label: ChangeProposalSpecification
definition: An authored proposal specifying a desired change and its intended target.

label: FeatureFlagSpecification
definition: A specification of a named feature-activation control and its intended scoping policy.

label: DeliveryStatusRecord
definition: An immutable dated report assigning a delivery-status value to one Release.

label: ReleaseEvidenceRecord
definition: An evidence-attribution record whose constitutive assessment purpose is release.

label: TaskReference
definition: A local reference artifact identifying an externally governed implementation task. Its implementation-task purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.

label: TestScenario
definition: A ScenarioSpecification describing a situation to verify specified behavior or conditions. It can be detailed enough to also be a TestCase; its described situation is not a completed TestExecution.

label: TestCase
definition: A ScenarioSpecification that includes an operational test procedure and expected conditions. Repeated executions reuse the specification and remain distinct events.

label: TestExecution
definition: A concluded real attempt to carry out one TestCase against one declared ProductRealization, including a setup-only aborted attempt or an unsuccessful exercised test, with one consolidated result. A planned run is not an occurrence. Only the evidenced code-exercised subset is a candidate for alignment to ROoST Test Execution.

label: TestResult
definition: The single consolidated outcome record for one concluded TestExecution in this reporting profile. Recording may occur after the attempt ends; this association does not assert creation during the attempt.

label: VerificationEvidenceRecord
definition: An evidence-attribution record whose constitutive assessment purpose is verification.

label: ValidationEvidenceRecord
definition: An evidence-attribution record whose constitutive assessment purpose is validation.

label: TestSuiteSpecification
definition: A governed test-organization specification containing references to test cases.

label: TestDataReference
definition: A local reference artifact identifying a versioned dataset used in test design or execution. Its test-data purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.

label: PositioningStatement
definition: An authored statement specifying intended product perception for a target audience relative to alternatives.

label: MessagingSpecification
definition: An authored specification of audience-directed messages and supporting claims.

label: GoToMarketSpecification
definition: A governed strategy specification linking positioning, audiences and intended market-entry activity.

label: LaunchSpecification
definition: A plan specification for introducing a product or change to an intended audience.

label: MarketingGoalSpecification
definition: A goal specification whose constitutive desired result concerns product marketing or market introduction.

label: TargetMarketReference
definition: A local reference artifact to an externally governed target market. Its target-market purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.

label: TargetSegmentReference
definition: A local reference artifact to an externally governed segment in an identified segmentation context. Its target-segment purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.

label: CompetitiveNarrative
definition: An authored narrative presenting scoped differentiation claims and their evidential references.

label: MarketingInsightReference
definition: A governed local reference artifact with one canonical target and an explicitly supplied owner identifier. Its marketing-insight purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.

label: AcquisitionHypothesisSpecification
definition: A hypothesis specification whose constitutive claim concerns acquiring intended users or customers.

label: AdoptionHypothesisSpecification
definition: A hypothesis specification whose constitutive claim concerns adoption barriers or adoption behavior.

label: AssessmentClaim
definition: An authored assessment-claim artifact fixing subject, criterion, scope and the proposition under consideration.

label: EvidenceAttributionRecord
definition: An information record documenting an assessor's attribution of one carrier to one assessment claim.

label: FindingRecord
definition: An authored observation or issue record with a fixed finding statement, subject bindings and provenance.

label: ExternalReferenceRecord
definition: A local information record of a fixed binding to a separately governed referent, with recorded authority, provenance and constitutive purpose set.

label: ConditionSpecification
definition: An authored semantic condition unit with a fixed proposition, applicability context and authoring provenance; distinct from a stakeholder intention, observed result or containing scenario.

label: ScenarioSpecification
definition: An authored structured situation description fixing context, preconditions, ordered stimulus/action description and expected condition units; distinct from each actual occurrence.

label: AssessmentContextSpecification
definition: An authored specification fixing the applicability boundary of an assessment, including its stated population, environment and temporal conditions, with optional version and scenario bindings.

label: DeliveryWorkItemStatusRecord
definition: An immutable dated information record assigning a status code under a stated scheme to one delivery work item, optionally qualified by one product version.
